data.narrative:
Physical Intelligence, founded by Karol Hausman, Sergey Levine, Chelsea Finn, and Brian Ichter, is a Series B stage AI & Software company with a current post-money valuation of $5.6B and $600M+ raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private-stage companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), with peer set including Figure AI, Reflection AI, Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, and Together AI spanning Series A through Series C stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.9x Series B to next-stage multiplier to the $5.6B base, yields $10.6B. Peer-median valuation across six same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables produces $12.0B, with the peer range spanning $3.2B to $39.0B. These methods reflect the significant valuation dispersion within the frontier AI sector at early-to-mid stages.

The triangulated valuation range is $9.0B (low) to $13.8B (high), with a median of $11.3B. This implies potential 60–150% upside from the current $5.6B valuation. Key uncertainties include stage-definition ambiguity among peers (Series A and Series C represented), the extreme outlier valuations in the comp set (particularly Figure AI at $39B), and limited public market anchors in this emerging subsector. The wide peer range reflects market pricing heterogeneity rather than fundamental clarity.
